description.en: Trailing 12-month revenue (USD billions) combines the last full year (67.357) with this year's reported year-to-date revenue (19.345) less the matching prior-year period (14.926).
description.zh: 最近十二个月营收以十亿 USD 计：上个完整财年 67.357，加本财年累计 19.345，减去上年同期累计 14.926。

description.en: The model holds disclosed period-end common shares outstanding constant. Additional future dilution may change per-share value.
description.zh: 模型固定采用已披露的期末流通普通股数。未来进一步稀释可能改变每股价值。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: Data-center delivery delays push out cloud revenue and financing weighs on margins.
rationale.zh: 数据中心交付延迟递延云收入，融资压缩利润率。

rationale.en: Backlog becomes billable as capital spending and depreciation rise.
rationale.zh: 积压订单逐步转为可计费收入，同时资本开支及折旧上升。

rationale.en: Capacity is deployed on time, supporting utilization and cash returns.
rationale.zh: 新增产能如期投用，支撑利用率及现金回报。
